title: Spartathlon 2026 — Race View results
claims: The official 2026 results page ends with finisher number 279, confirming 279 official finishers.
The top three men are Tamás Bódis (HUN) in 19:40:51, Fotis Zisimopoulos (GRE) in 20:32:41 and Tomi Ronkainen (FIN) in 21:26:36.
The top three women are Despoina Simantrakou (GRE) in 24:45:43, Radka Churaňová (CZE) in 26:05:56 and Lemonia Panagiotou (GRE) in 26:58:04.
The results page lists Simantrakou's finishing clock time as 27/09/2026 07:45:43, i.e. 24:45:43 after the 07:00 start.
The results page does not label Bódis's 19:40:51 as an official course record; media reports describe it as a record, but that is not an official page claim.
